It doesn't state expected outcome of `just setup`/`just build`, except services. The quick start expected outcome is opening URL. For HTTPS step 5 start dev environment and open URL. The criteria says consider whether guide explained technical terms/concepts or required you to know them beforehand. It requires knowledge of Rust, Docker, Node, just, etc. It doesn't explain them. However prerequisites list links. It says "for a development setup with hot reload", maybe okay. It explains PWA service worker disabled in dev. But no definitions. So maybe 3 adequate; not excellent because many terms unexplained.
